limitations: This package is not a title opinion. It does not establish beneficial ownership, current site control, or complete title research.

doc_type classification uses the NYC DOF ACRIS Document Control Codes dataset (7isb-wh4c) where available; the keyword fallback is flagged per record.
ACRIS legals are queried by exact BBL; documents in which this parcel appears only as a secondary legal are not collected. other_parcels reflects only documents collected in this run.

current_owner.reason: A defensible current-owner conclusion requires a complete chain of title from the latest recorded conveyance to the present, including unrecorded interests, liens, corrections and any post-recording transfers. This package contains index rows only and does not perform that research; the recorded grantee evidence above is not a current-owner conclusion.
